_README: Cloud preparation only. The allowlist hash is a placeholder until operator-run allowlist setup is completed. No trading authorization or successful checks are implied. Contains public configuration only; all paths are on the cloud host.
_signerAddress: The bot wallet: it signs, pays gas and holds every position.
_owner: Your own address, the only one the signer's supervised sweeps can ever send to. Must differ from signerAddress.
_allowlist: The signer's policy file, built once with `node <signer path> allowlist-init` (operator-run), committed in your private copy, and its sha256.
_planner: rpcGapMs and parallel pace the planner's RPC reads.
_dirs: Cloud-only paths outside the checkout: /workspace/r3-runtime/tools for planner/helper, /workspace/r3-runtime/signer for signer, /workspace/r3-runtime/keys for private credential files, and /workspace/r3-runtime/state for signer lock/log. Configure matching credential-access restrictions for these exact cloud paths before any private values are supplied. The reviewed install writes key files only when R3_KEYSTORE_JSON and R3_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD are both privately configured. Never commit those files or values.
_git: Who commits the run records, and to which branch, when a routine pushes them (--push).
